caption: The drawing depicts a single, cylindrical metal container with a fitted lid and a handle on top. The container is primarily brown in color, with decorative yellow patterns on both the lid and the upper and lower edges of the container. There is a lock mechanism on the front side. A cream-colored band runs horizontally around the middle of the container, featuring painted decorations that include a large green leaf-like shape at the center and several red circular spots to either side. The background is a plain, light beige with no other objects or elements present. The artist’s signature, "C. Henning," appears in the lower left corner.
title: Toleware Box
